cli.help: Autopilot Harness — Planning → Executing agent harness

autopilot_on.description: Start Planning — discuss what to build

review.fix: Review fix round {round}: inspect the full diff, fix CRITICAL/HIGH issues, run relevant tests. Do not commit.
review.confirm: Review confirm {n}/{total} — Lens ({lensTitle}): {lensFocus}. Stay on this lens only. Do not commit.
review.confirm_final: Review confirm {n}/{total} — Lens ({lensTitle}): {lensFocus}. Read-only final lens; do not change code or commit.

followup.advance: Advance checklist: mark current item [x], scoped conventional commit if dirty, then implement next item: {nextId} — {nextTitle}.
followup.done: All checklist items done. Mark the last item [x], scoped commit if needed, then stop.
followup.recover: Recover: the previous turn ended with an error. Continue the current checklist item without advancing.
followup.stuck: Stuck: no progress for several stops. Change strategy or send Autopilot RESUME after fixing.
followup.verify_fix: Verify failed ({reason}). Fix verify commands and rewrite verify-last.json; do not advance.
followup.track_pick: Select a plan by number or slug.

error.one_executor_busy: Another session is already executing ({track}). OFF or wait, then retry.
error.on_while_executing: Autopilot is executing. Send Autopilot OFF, REPLAN, or RESUME before ON.

scope-correctness.title: Scope & correctness
scope-correctness.focus: Within the current checklist item scope: logic, invariants, alignment with plan.md.

boundaries.title: Boundaries & errors
boundaries.focus: Null/empty, bounds, error paths, failure rollback.

security.title: Security
security.focus: Authz, injection, sensitive data, trust boundaries.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.focus: Races, transactions, partial failure; N/A if inapplicable.

tests-regression.title: Tests & regression
tests-regression.focus: Missing tests, weak asserts, contract drift; read-only.
